summary: Pin is in park bush with no way in; kerb opposite faces a school.
reasons: Pin itself has no track or vehicles
Cars park on kerb beside school grounds
Busy road, no homes within 50 m

drivers.seclusion: Park and oval on one side, school grounds on the other; nearest school building 54 m and no dwellings mapped within 100 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin sits in grass and trees, no tyre tracks or vehicles; only a dirt foot path to the oval. Parked cars line the road's east kerb.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with traffic and powerlines; cars park along the kerb.
drivers.convention: School-side parking looks daytime; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Slope: local max 8.8% but kerb grade gentle
sun_shade: Street trees give patchy shade from the east side; kerb mostly open to afternoon sun.

best_section.where: East kerb of the main road, 50-70 m north-north-east of the pin, beside school playing field
